basis: the announced surface is the value: EditablePreview renders as a <button> at rest and swaps to the EditableInput text input while editing, with labelled submit/cancel <button>s and a role="status" span for refusals.

exceptions.because: editable.e2e.ts presses the edit's real keyboard surface in browser — Enter opening, Escape abandoning with focus handed back, focus mode opening on arrival without re-opening on its own hand-back, the read-only value seating without opening — but the commit half is exactly what the interaction-level defect below leaves unproven, so the spec cites the open/abandon halves only; the role-axis evidence tranche owns un-qualifying this row
e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432)

interaction.basis: one edit target that swaps view and edit modes on its own state.

harness.because: witnesses only the open/abandon half — Enter opening, Escape restoring with focus handed back once, focus mode arriving and leaving, read-only seating — while the commit gesture stays unproven

exceptions.because: the Enter commit does not return to the preview: in the harness the keydown fires the submit event and the committed value lands in the model — the demo prints it — but the editor stays open holding the value with the Save and Cancel buttons beside it, so a keyboard commit leaves the surface in edit mode where a pointer commit would have returned to rest (observed in the harness; the mechanism is not pinned — the unit tier passes because jsdom's trigger("keydown") runs the key handler without the focus swap the commit is supposed to perform); tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432
